name: ohmypet-backend
description: OhMyPet serverless backend — AI pet poster generation

scripts.build: rimraf dist && esbuild src/functions/generate/handler.ts src/functions/status/handler.ts src/functions/worker/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outdir=dist/functions --outbase=src/functions --external:@aws-sdk/*
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sam build && sam deploy
